note: A page constructing a BarcodeDetector must not kill the app (W6-D31): the WebView's shape-detection binding runs the Play services client's manifest check, which threw across the JNI boundary on the in-process GPU thread. The crash needs the Chromium snapshot WebView (the images' WebView 113 did not show it) and no form factor, so it rides the tablet-webview shard, which has the room the webview shard has not (the workflow's own job is the phone, pixel_6). On the AOSP image detect() rejects NotSupportedError; the process lives.
